reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter all the time, so a sachet that's already counted for the evening actually fits how I am. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy if a creator's video hits the sleep or recovery thing.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Is bisglycinate alone really enough, or am I paying for a nicer box?
would_change_my_mind: If it was $29.99 with no launch price I'd probably skip it. Seeing a creator I trust explain why bisglycinate alone is enough would also help.
